vex/functions/scatter: Picks points at random from a list, weighted by a value.
shelf/scatter: The shelf button that adds a Scatter node to the selected object.
nodes/sop/scatteralign: Scatters points and gives each one a random size and turn.
nodes/sop/scatterintexturemask: Scatters points where a texture is bright.
nodes/sop/pyroscatterfromburst: Makes points for a burst of fire or smoke.
vex/functions/anoise: Noise with sharp creases, like rock or a crumpled sheet.
vex/functions/curlnoise: Noise that swirls without gathering, for smoke and fluids.
vex/functions/flownoise: Noise that moves along with time, for animated fluids.
vex/functions/onoise: The original Perlin noise, kept for old scenes.
vex/functions/snoise: Sparse convolution noise, with fewer grid marks.
vex/functions/pnoise: Noise that repeats after a period you set.
vex/functions/xnoise: Simplex noise: smooth, and quick in more dimensions.
vex/functions/wnoise: Worley noise: cells, like stone or skin.
nodes/sop/copyxform: Makes copies of its input, each moved a step further.
nodes/sop/copytocurves: Copies a shape along a curve, turned to follow it.
nodes/sop/copy: The older copy node, with a stamp for each copy.
vex/functions/noised: Perlin noise, and how fast it changes in each direction.
vex/functions/xnoised: Simplex noise, and how fast it changes in each direction.
vex/functions/gxnoise: Simplex noise with a smoother look, less like a grid.
vex/functions/gxnoised: The same smoother noise, and how fast it changes.
vex/functions/pxnoise: Simplex noise that repeats after a period you set.
vex/functions/pxnoised: Repeating simplex noise, and how fast it changes.
vex/functions/vnoise: Voronoi noise: the distance to the nearest cell point.
vex/functions/cwnoise: Worley noise with the cells kept in a box you set.
vex/functions/mwnoise: Worley noise measured the Manhattan way: square cells.
vex/functions/curlnoise2d: Curl noise flat on a plane, for 2D flows.
vex/functions/curlxnoise: Curl noise made from simplex noise.
vex/functions/curlxnoise2d: Simplex curl noise, flat on a plane.
vex/functions/curlgxnoise: Curl noise made from the smoother simplex noise.
vex/functions/curlgxnoise2d: Smoother simplex curl noise, flat on a plane.
vex/functions/flowpnoise: Moving noise that repeats after a period you set.
vex/functions/hscript_noise: The noise of the old expression language, for old scenes.
vex/functions/hscript_snoise: The sparse noise of the old expression language.
vex/functions/mx_cellnoise: Cell noise as MaterialX draws it: one value per cell.
